ICS 13.110; 79.120.10PGD 35New Standard from Last Update.NATIONAL FOREWORDThis Indian Standard (Part 10) which is identical with ISO 19085-10 : 2018 ‘Woodworking machines - Safety - Part 10: Building site saws (contractor saws)’ issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO), was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards after the draft finalized by Machine Tools, Machine Tool Elements and Holding Devices Sectional Committee had been approved by the Production and General Engineering Division Council.Other parts in this series are:Part 1 Common requirementsPart 2 Horizontal beam panel circular sawing MachinesPart 3 Numerically controlled (NC) boring and routing machinesPart 4 Vertical panel circular sawing MachinesPart 5 Dimension sawsPart 6 Single spindle vertical moulding machines ("toupies")Part 7 Surface planning, thickness planning, combined surface/thickness planning machinesPart 8 Belt sanding and calibrating machines for straight workpiecesPart 9 Circular saw benches (with and without sliding table)
